title: Dort: this working is supernatural and infallible (article 12)
source_text: XLIII. Articulo vero sequenti addit eam Dei operationem esse plane supernaturalem, potentissimam simul & suavissimam, mirabilem, arcanam & ineffabilem, virtute sua nec creatione, nec mortuorum resuscitatione minorem aut inferiorem: adeo ut omnes illi, in quorum cordibus admirando hoc modo Deus operatur, certo, infallibiliter & efficaciter regenerentur, & actu credant.
pass_a_gloss: XLIII. But in the following article it adds that this operation of God is plainly supernatural, at once most powerful & most sweet, wonderful, secret & ineffable, in its power neither less nor inferior to creation, nor to the raising of the dead: so that all those, in whose hearts God works in this admirable manner, are certainly, infallibly & efficaciously regenerated, & actually believe.
pass_b_english: Thesis XLIII. In the next article the Synod adds that this working of God is wholly supernatural, both most powerful and most gentle, wonderful, hidden and beyond words, and no less in power than creation or the raising of the dead. So all in whose hearts God works in this wonderful way are regenerated surely, infallibly and effectively, and actually believe.
